rows.criteria: Client/Architectural Coordination (DT03.02.04): Confirm architectural updates have been reflected in FrameCAD models
Housekeeping of Project Files (DT09.01.03): Apply correct file naming conventions (e.g. 24313-ARCH-FloorPlan-RevC.pdf)
Housekeeping of Project Files (DT09.01.01): Maintain correct project folder structure based on company templates (e.g. Docs, DWGs, RFIs)
FrameCAD Structure (DT11.01.03): Import an architectural floor plans
Peer Review: A thorough, detailed peer review carried out on every project (not just treated as a hold point), so errors and issues are caught before the work progresses.
Peer Review Comments Closed Out: All peer review comments actioned and checked off before the drawings are issued.
Drawing Registration & Issue Control (DT05.01.04): Issue drawings with correct transmittal process
Communication with Clients & Site (DT01.01.02): Interpret builder markups and translate into design changes
Aconex (DT11.06.07): Apply revision and status codes correctly
Housekeeping of Project Files (DT09.01.07): Record upload dates, version details, or updates in Smartsheet or the design coordination log
Email Trail: All emails on the same RFI, query or technical issue kept in one thread; a new thread started in Outlook, Aconex or Procore when the subject changes significantly.
Communication with Clients & Site (DT01.01.05): Document phone or site conversations as action items
